description: My Store Guard (beta): problems anyone can see on your own store from outside, such as ads landing on dead pages, most products out of stock, prices dropped to 0, a domain or certificate about to expire, lookalike domains, AI crawlers blocked or no robots.txt, low AI readiness and URL structure changes, each with the address, what was seen and when, and how to fix it. Based on public data: an early indicator, not a full audit. Owned store only (for rivals use find_ads_with_broken_pages_or_expired_offers). Areas: ads, pages, products, ai, trust, brand; areas we could not check are listed as not_checked, never as fine. Open issues by default; include_fixed / include_ignored add those.

area.description: Only this area: ads, pages, products, ai, trust or brand. Omit for all six.

domain.description: Your own store domain, if you have more than one; omit for your store. Rival domains are refused.

include_fixed.description: Also list issues fixed in the last 30 days (default false).

include_ignored.description: Also list issues your team ignored, with the reason (default false).

name: find_public_problems_on_my_store
title: My Store Guard
